alpha.reason: two-sided significance level for every paired test; the conventional value, declared

power.reason: the power at which the minimum n and the noise floor are computed; conventional, declared

reviewed_set.reason: the review sample the gate reads by default: the first thirty case ids of reviews/order.txt, which is what a team that reviews thirty summaries has; `all` reads the full review the fixture paid for

merge_field_families.reason: Input and Flow are in the Metadata API sample; RelatedList, Apex and EinsteinSearch are declared (ADR-005)

related_list_rendering.reason: how the resolved prompt renders one related-list record; the platform's rendering is not documented, so this is declared

retriever_rendering.reason: how the resolved prompt renders one retrieved chunk; declared for the same reason

bootstrap.reason: the readers' second interval; seeded so two runs agree

draws.reason: experiment 2's thirties drawn from the full review; seeded

score_range.reason: a review score outside this range is refused with the file and row named

grounding_sources.reason: which merge-field family brings each source kind into the resolved prompt; a claim is supported only by a source the template merged in
